# cache-lifetime-policy

行为约定：
cache.service.expiresAt(header, storedAtMs) computes shared cache expiration or null. header is a string or array of strings containing comma-separated Cache-Control directives; directive names are case-insensitive and surrounding spaces are ignored. 'private' or 'no-store' anywhere forbids caching regardless of other directives. Accept max-age only as unquoted or double-quoted nonnegative ASCII integer digits; choose the smallest of ALL valid max-age values. Ignore unknown and malformed directives. If no valid max-age return null; max-age=0 expires at storedAtMs. Convert seconds to milliseconds exactly; throw RangeError if the accepted TTL or computed timestamp cannot be represented as a safe integer. storedAtMs is a nonnegative safe integer. Do not mutate header arrays.

运行：`node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`。
只使用运行时标准库；保持公开接口及原有断言，不安装依赖，不联网。
